component.name: Lumina
component.summary: Local-first dynamic island for notifications, media, and system status

description.p: Lumina is a compact desktop overlay that expands when something deserves attention and collapses when it does not. It shows media, notifications, system metrics, and configurable widgets without taking over the desktop.
It is local-first: no account, no telemetry, no auto-update, and no listening network socket. The optional weather widget is the only component that makes a network request.
Alpha engine and headless tooling. The runtime window is not yet wired.
